_comment: S1 — 角色級佔格表 (footprint tiers). docs/ART_AND_ABILITY_DESIGN.md §1.7 / rule F8:
佔格 is a CHARACTER-level property, not a per-floor knob, so it lives here once per enemy type
instead of being repeated inside every stage file. A stage file can still override any single
tile with its own top-level "footprints" map (keyed by the tile char), and a floor that says
nothing keeps the tier from this table.
Legal sizes are 1x1, 2x1, 1x2 and 2x2 only (F1): a maze cell is 2x2 tiles and passages are 2
tiles wide, so anything else cannot be aligned to the cell subdivision and the generator could
not guarantee it a passage. Each grid keeps its own 32px of art density (F2), so a 2-grid enemy
is more detail, not a scaled-up sprite.
Tiers in the art document: 30 types at 1 grid, 8 types at 2 grids (大型・壓迫感), 12 boss/event
entities at 4 grids (首領／特殊事件). Only types that already exist in data are listed; the
remaining roster arrives with the art pass (S8) and the generated floors (S2).
A footprint is only ever applied where it physically fits: footprint_test.cpp validates every
shipped stage (legal size, all occupied tiles walkable, no overlap, stairs still reachable with
the bigger blockers) and fails loudly if a floor file stops satisfying that.
"name" is the banner text for the 4-grid tier; "roamer": true additionally makes it wander the
floor and chase the player (see src/game/roamer.h).
